items.title: Saudi Arabia's date production rises 7.6% to over 2 million tons in 2025
items.source_excerpt: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia's date production rose 7.6 percent year-on-year to over 2 million tons in 2025, while the number of palm trees reached 37.9 million, including 34.7 million fruit-bearing trees. The General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT) revealed in its Agricultural Statistics 2025 report that the Khalas variety led date production at 654,800 tons, with 11.1 million palm trees, including 10.2 million fruit-bearing trees. Meanwhile, total grain production reached approximately 1.5 million tons, with wheat accounting for 65.8 percent, or 965,700 tons, down 18.6 percent compared with 2024.
